paper_metadata.title: Contextual Quantum Neural Networks for Stock Price Prediction

experiments.description: Loading a contextual probability distribution for Apple stock returns into a 3-qubit quantum state using a hardware-efficient ansatz and fidelity-based training.

algorithm.variant: contextual distribution loading with hardware-efficient ansatz
algorithm.ansatz: hardware-efficient ansatz with repeated RY, RZ, and CNOT layers
algorithm.parameter_initialization: random seed 42; other initialization details not reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary quantization of stock returns into 2 levels; 3 context qubits encode three consecutive days of Apple returns; contextual distribution P(X(T)) loaded as amplitudes.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize MSE between loaded quantum state and target contextual distribution; fidelity loss via SWAP test is also used in training.

problem_instance.description: Apple stock contextual distribution loading experiment.

dataset_specification.description: Apple stock prices from the S&P 500; 10,033 prices averaged weekly with stride length 1 day, yielding 10,029 samples; binary discretization where 0 indicates price decrease and 1 indicates price increase; 80/20 train-test split.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Compute finite differences (returns), apply moving average smoothing, normalize preprocessed data, compute histogram to obtain contextual probability distribution, binary quantization.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Training loss over epochs; qualitative comparison of loaded vs intended contextual distribution.

hardware.device_name: AerSimulator not explicitly named for this experiment

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Finite differences, moving average smoothing, normalization, histogram-based probability estimation, binary quantization.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Training loss visualization and distribution comparison.

experiments.description: Quantum single-task learning for next-day stock distribution prediction on Apple and Google using a 4-layer PQC, SWAP-test fidelity loss, and SPSA.

algorithm.variant: quantum single-task learning (QSTL) with contextual prediction
algorithm.ansatz: layered parametric quantum circuit with fixed gates and single-qubit rotations
algorithm.parameter_initialization: random seed 42; other initialization details not reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: 3 qubits encode the contextual distribution; 1 prediction qubit; 4 additional qubits encode the target conditional distribution for SWAP-test comparison.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Learn P(X_{T+1} | X(T)) by minimizing fidelity loss between predicted and target conditional distributions.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: SWAP test compares predicted and target states; ancilla-mediated fidelity loss.

problem_instance.description: Next-day conditional stock price distribution prediction for Apple and Google.
problem_instance.dataset_name: S&P 500 / Apple and Google stock data

dataset_specification.description: Apple and Google stock prices from the S&P 500; same preprocessing as contextual loading; binary quantization; 80/20 split; 3000 epochs.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Finite differences (returns), moving average smoothing, normalization, histogram-based contextual distribution, binary quantization.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Predicted conditional distributions compared to target distributions; KL divergence reported; training curves shown.

hardware.device_name: AerSimulator not explicitly named for this experiment

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Finite differences, moving average smoothing, normalization, histogram-based probability estimation, binary quantization.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: KL divergence computation between predicted and target conditional distributions.

experiments.description: Quantum multi-task learning on two assets (Apple and Google) using the share-and-specify ansatz and sequential task training.

algorithm.variant: quantum multi-task learning (QMTL) with share-and-specify ansatz
algorithm.ansatz: share-and-specify ansatz with shared layers and label-controlled task-specific layers
algorithm.parameter_initialization: random seed 42; other initialization details not reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: 3 context qubits plus 1 prediction qubit; 1 label qubit distinguishes Apple vs Google; shared circuit acts on all tasks and task-specific gates are label-controlled.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Jointly learn conditional distributions for multiple assets while sharing parameters across tasks.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Label-controlled gates select the active task-specific circuit; SWAP test used for fidelity loss.

problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Predicted conditional distributions compared to targets; KL divergence reported; convergence curves compared against QSTL.

algorithm.variant: quantum multi-task learning (QMTL) with share-and-specify ansatz

algorithm.parameter_initialization: random seed 42; other initialization details not reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: 3 context qubits plus 1 prediction qubit; 2 externally controlled label qubits select among 4 task-specific circuits; Toffoli gates implement label control.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Jointly learn conditional distributions for four assets with shared and task-specific parameters.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Toffoli/X-gate label control; SWAP test fidelity loss.
